text:
Aline: Quick sync. We need one tight landing update for next week's micro-launch + a short social/webinar cadence. Goals: single demo CTA, clear tri-mode hero copy, simple lead tagging. Short owners list and ship timeline.

Manny: thumbs up. share the proposed hero lines?

Aline: Pasted draft: ```
Hosted: Start with a dev key — pay-as-you-go inference.
Dedicated: Predictable capacity for production throughput.
Private: VPC & on-prem with enterprise controls and auditability.
CTA: Book a demo / Try API (single CTA, pass mode param)
Form: mode selector -> tag -> route to queue
```

Jamie: For Dedicated, prefer the phrase "predictable capacity" (less "GPU" talk). Also let's keep each hero under 7 words.

Sophie: For the launch post and webinar blurb we should include a one-line performance claim without numbers: "production-grade latency and consistent unit costs." Short social variant: "See inference that scales predictably. Webinar Thu 10am."

Tom: Routing plan: single form with hidden/visible `mode`. On submit: POST -> CRM with tag. Rules: 
```
if mode=="private": assign->enterprise-AE
elif mode=="dedicated": assign->capacity-specialist
else: assign->growth-inbound
```
Add utm_campaign=microlaunch, utm_source=web.

Rei: I can run a 48hr hero placement test (hero vs inline demo box). I'll instrument `cta_click` event with props `mode` and `variant`. Need final hero copy by EOD to wire tracking.

Jamie: I'll refine copy to short hero lines and hand to design by 2pm. Suggest examples: 
Hosted hero: "Start building with low-friction inference"
Dedicated hero: "Predictable capacity for production"
Private hero: "Private deployment, enterprise controls"

Aline: Nice. Sophie, can you produce two benchmark blurbs: one for the landing (full sentence) and one for social (snappy). Also draft a 1-line webinar promo.

launch-bot: Reminder: Webinar "Production inference patterns" scheduled Thu 10:00. Current signups: 5.

Sophie: Drafts below: 
Landing blurb: "Production-grade latency and consistent economics across hosted, dedicated, or private deployments."
Social blurb: "Predictable latency and cost for LLM inference. Join our webinar Thu 10am."
Webinar one-liner: "How to run inference reliably across hosted, dedicated, and private modes."

Manny: I'll schedule two launch posts: one announcing the blog + webinar, another for demo signups. Posting cadence: Tue noon (announce), Wed afternoon (reminder), Thu 30m before (live push).

Tom: Routing stub done in staging. Will add assignment mapping and test flows.

Rei: Tracking ready. Will test with staging CTA tomorrow.

Aline: Great. Owners recap: Jamie = copy, Sophie = benchmark blurbs + webinar lines, Manny = social schedule, Tom = routing CR and QA, Rei = tracking A/B. We'll reconvene 4pm PT for final signoff and push morning hero variant at 9am Wed. Thanks! :rocket:
